prompt: Write one paragraph (120-200 words) for a slide speaker note summarizing progression-free survival with pembrolizumab plus carboplatin-paclitaxel in KEYNOTE-868/NRG-GY018, by MMR status. Use both SOURCES and attribute every number to its source.

rubric.criterion: Notices that the label (interim PFS analysis; n=110/112 and 294/294) and the registry (n=113/112 and 295/293; different medians) report different analyses and does not mix numbers from the two.
Every number is attributed to the correct source and copied exactly.
Correct by-cohort interpretation: benefit in both dMMR and pMMR; magnitude larger in dMMR; OS immature.
Concise and usable as a speaker note.

notes_for_reviewer: This is the expert trap of the set. Label: placebo dMMR median 6.5, pMMR 11.1 vs 8.5 months. Registry: placebo dMMR 7.6, pMMR 11.7 vs 8.7 months.
